definitions.explanation: A Japanese-style omelet made by rolling thin layers of seasoned beaten egg in a rectangular pan. A staple of bento boxes and sushi toppings.

examples.japanese: {卵焼|たまごや}きを{作|つく}った。
お{弁当|べんとう}に{卵焼|たまごや}きを{入|い}れるのが{定番|ていばん}だ。
examples.english: Including tamagoyaki in a bento is standard.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}の{卵焼|たまごや}きは{少|すこ}し{甘|あま}くて、{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からの{好物|こうぶつ}だった。
examples.english: My mother's tamagoyaki was slightly sweet and had been my favorite food since childhood.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTES: One of the most common home-cooked Japanese dishes. Seasoning varies by region and family: {関東|かんとう} (eastern Japan) tends to make it sweet with sugar and {出汁|だし}, while {関西|かんさい} (western Japan) tends toward a more savory, {出汁|だし}-flavored version called {出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}.

A special rectangular pan called {卵焼|たまごや}き{器|き} is used to roll the layers. {卵焼|たまごや}き is also a popular sushi topping ({寿司|すし}ネタ), especially at {築地|つきじ} and other famous markets.
